answer: Give each identity a capability bond built from verifiable work history, not a balance. An agent earns its ridge standing only by completing jobs that independent clients countersign on-chain, and reputation decays each epoch unless fresh, distinct work renews it, so a dormant fake cannot coast. The ivory test is simple: a new identity with no history gets zero earning power, no matter how many siblings it spawns. At its nadir, a Sybil farm must pay the full price of real, client-checked work per identity, while one honest agent pays that cost once.
